name: mi-marketplace
description: Mis agentes especializados para Claude Code

plugins.name: plan
plugins.description: Pipeline completo de planificación de producto: ideación → PRD → User Stories → Backlog → Épicas → Tickets técnicos. Incluye agentes especializados por rol (Product Owner, Business Analyst, Tech Lead).

plugins.name: ng-kit
plugins.description: Angular development toolkit: scaffold landing pages, create apps, build features, review code, migrate to signals, write tests, and fix builds.

plugins.name: ai-dev
plugins.description: Toolkit de IA orientado a producción: agentes LangGraph, RAG, ingeniería de prompts, búsqueda vectorial y evaluación de LLMs.

plugins.name: ui-design
plugins.description: Diseño UI/UX para móvil (iOS, Android, React Native) y web: sistemas de diseño, accesibilidad y patrones modernos.

plugins.name: python-dev
plugins.description: Toolkit Python de producción: scaffolding, features, auth, observabilidad, testing y CI/CD para FastAPI, Django y GraphQL.

plugins.name: ds-angular-storybook
plugins.description: Angular Design System generator powered by PRD. From a Product Requirements Document, generates complete design systems: tokens, components (atoms → organisms), layout system, Storybook catalog, and Jest tests.

plugins.name: code-documentation
plugins.description: Documentation generation, code explanation, and technical writing with automated doc generation and tutorial creation

plugins.name: agent-config
plugins.description: Genera y gestiona la configuración completa de agentes/subagentes según agentskills.io: AGENTS.md, skills, setup.sh, sync y soporte multi-asistente (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot).

plugins.name: react-dev-suite
plugins.description: Professional React development toolkit covering React 18/19, TypeScript, hooks, state management, routing, data fetching, forms, validation, styling (Tailwind + MUI), performance, testing, SSR, build tools, and migration patterns.

plugins.name: java-springboot
plugins.description: Comprehensive Java and Spring Boot development toolkit. Covers Spring Boot 3.x/4.x, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, reactive programming, messaging, testing, DevOps, and AI integration for professional Java enterprise development.
